description: This file implements a Kinect depth viewer application using Kivy, including shader code for visualizing depth data, threading for Kinect data acquisition, and a GUI with controls for visualization modes.

classes.name: KinectDepth
classes.description: Thread class for acquiring Kinect depth data asynchronously.

classes.name: KinectViewer
classes.description: Kivy Widget for displaying Kinect depth data with shader effects.

classes.name: KinectViewerApp
classes.description: Kivy App class managing the Kinect viewer interface and settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Thread run method for continuously fetching depth data from Kinect.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Retrieve the latest depth data from the queue.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for KinectViewer widget, initializes shaders, texture, and Kinect thread.

methods.name: on_index
methods.description: Callback to update Kinect device index.

methods.name: update_transformation
methods.description: Updates the shader uniforms and texture with latest depth data.

methods.name: build_settings
methods.description: Creates the settings panel for the app.
